info.title: Operix Industrial AI Safety Platform
info.description: Operix Industrial AI Safety Platform — Core Backend REST API & Real-Time Engine. Integrates Computer Vision events, deterministic safety rules, multi-channel alerts, and bilingual AI assistant services.

post.summary: Issue a one-time WebSocket authentication ticket
post.description: Exchanges a valid human JWT for a short-lived (≤30 s) signed WS ticket. The ticket is stored atomically in Redis and consumed on first use. Requires active factory membership. Fails closed if Redis is unavailable.
